title: Concept Aster 3BR — cross-vent musalla
blurb: Concept layout with wind-ready shell and a dedicated prayer room zone. Designed for coastal high-wind sites with natural cross-ventilation.

title: Concept Delta 4BR courtyard
blurb: Family-centered courtyard plan with stack ventilation and shaded overhangs. Central garden creates a private outdoor living space.

title: Concept Nova 2BR infill
blurb: Narrow-footprint row-home concept for dense urban rebuilding parcels. Efficient 2-storey layout maximises usable floor space on tight lots.

title: Concept Atlas 3BR compact
blurb: Compact envelope concept tuned for lower heat loss in cold seasons. Steep gable roof sheds snow and thick walls retain warmth.

title: Concept Tide 4BR raised
blurb: Elevated concept with flood-resilient raised base and protected utilities on stilts. External staircase provides safe access above flood levels.

title: Concept Vale 3BR accessible
blurb: Mixed-climate concept with wheelchair-friendly wide doorways, ramp entry, and open-plan layout. No internal steps.
